about_short_description.short_description: RasMal is a simple and powerful tools for captable management, equity plans, investment rounds and more.

product.name: Equity Ownership Management
product.description: A system to issue and record various types of shares for founders, investors, and employees, maintaining an organized and clear cap table.

product.name: Investment Round Management
product.description: A platform to facilitate fundraising rounds, including negotiation of investment terms and due diligence processes.

product.name: Company Valuation Reporting
product.description: A tool to generate company valuation reports based on qualitative and quantitative data inputs.

product.name: Investor Reporting and Communication
product.description: A service to create and share professional reports and key company data with investors to support fundraising and governance.

product.name: Data Security and Access Control
product.description: Features to secure company data with encryption, access permissions, and watermarking to protect sensitive information.
